Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name or label of the key.

AdditionalIdentification.name: Additional Identification
AdditionalIdentification.definition: Additional identification of the key, for instance to derive the key.

SequenceCounter.name: Sequence Counter
SequenceCounter.definition: Sequence counter of the cryptographic key.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of algorithm used by the cryptographic key.

ActivationDate.name: Activation Date
ActivationDate.definition: Date and time on which the key must be activated.

DeactivationDate.name: Deactivation Date
DeactivationDate.definition: Date and time on which the key must be deactivated.

KeyCheckValue.name: Key Check Value
KeyCheckValue.definition: Value for checking a cryptographic key.

FailureReason.name: Failure Reason
FailureReason.definition: Reason for which the key has been stopped.
